svg.title: The procurement case from plan to closing
svg.desc: The activity starts from a plan item and the published plan, passes the requisition and the method decision, splits into the specific and competitive routes, then joins at the winner, contract, acceptance, payment and closing.

g.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: Add a plan item, create the case at step 1

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: Propose, approve and publish the plan, record the e-GP notice

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: Raise a requisition, reserve the amount on the line

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: Return or reject, release the reservation

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: no

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: Authorised approver approves?

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: yes

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: Advise the method, officer chooses, head approves a differing choice

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: Reference price, TOR, committees

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: Specific method?

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: yes

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: no

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: Record quotations, choose one

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: Record the e-GP notice, closing and bidder count

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: Enter bid summaries, declare conflicts, score

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: Record the award, start the appeal period

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: Draft the contract and phases, record the guarantee

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: Sign, convert the reservation to a commitment

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: Record the delivery, compute the penalty

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: Committee accepts, signs, certificates issued

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: Record the invoice, pass the payment gate

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: Finance requests and approves payment

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: no

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: Phases left?

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: yes

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: Warranty ends, guarantee returned or forfeited

text.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif

g.text: Write lessons, score the supplier, close the case
